verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a public REST API (v3) for building custom integrations and automating workspace workflows. The docs list concrete create, delete and list endpoints and say machine-readable Swagger/OpenAPI specs are provided. The probes only show the spec is not at common guessed paths, which does not contradict that the documented API exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, a located machine-readable OpenAPI spec (standard paths returned 404), evidence on auth and rate-limit documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can use this API to build custom integrations or automate even more of your workspace’s workflow.
Create Category allows you to create a new Category in Shortcut.
Delete Category can be used to delete any Category.
We provide machine-readable versions of our API specified in Swagger and OpenAPI.
